description: A form in the agent's reply using every input: values the user entered (neoui.input), a failed email check after pressing Deploy, a link button.

events.text:
```neoui
<Form name="deploy">
  <FormControl label="Service">
    <Select name="service" placeholder="Pick a service" required>
      <Option value="api">API</Option>
      <Option value="web">Web app</Option>
      <Option value="worker">Worker</Option>
    </Select>
  </FormControl>
  <FormControl label="Notify email" hint="We send the report here">
    <Input name="email" placeholder="you@company.com" type="email" required/>
  </FormControl>
  <FormControl label="Environment">
    <RadioGroup name="env" value="staging">
      <Option value="staging">Staging</Option>
      <Option value="prod">Production</Option>
    </RadioGroup>
  </FormControl>
  <FormControl label="Notes"><TextArea name="notes" placeholder="Anything the reviewers should know"/></FormControl>
  <FormControl label="Date"><DatePicker name="when"/></FormControl>
  <FormControl label="Canary traffic"><Slider name="canary" min={0} max={50} step={5}/></FormControl>
  <Switch name="notify" label="Post to #deploys"/>
  <CheckBox name="agree" label="I checked the migration" required/>
  <Buttons>
    <Button id="deploy" variant="primary" ui-ask="Deploy with these settings">Deploy</Button>
    <Button id="docs" href="https://example.com/runbook">Runbook</Button>
  </Buttons>
</Form>
```
